name: Tsubaki Makoto
source:
"Ahaha. That's good and funny. I've decided you're my next target."

A reporter for the magazine "Yuzuha" who is always looking for sensational stories. The stories he handles change from time to time. He is willing to team up with anyone and take on a certain amount of dangerous work, depending on how rewarding it is.

He is always aloof and a good liar who is also good at evading revealing his true intentions, but on the other hand, he never lies in his work.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/tsubaki_makoto.html]official website[/url]]
